items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Yeah, he had Joe Oliver spitting lumps of blood right there at that corner praying around for us.

ctx.x: Joe Oliver on one side, Manuel Perez on this side. Manuel put his browns on that little trumpet he had. And he started playing. When he got through, he had Joe Oliver spitting lumps of blood like that, trying to catch him. Yeah, he had Joe Oliver spitting lumps of blood right there at that corner praying around for us.
Manuel Perez used the derby too and all of them. Yeah.
